summary: The observations OTLP exporter also sends account limits as a bounded gauge and counts the claims each node stores by kind and writer; the docs name the observation log as the full harness telemetry series

replay.detail: No claim is written or replayed differently. The exporter reads the local observation log as before, and reads the kind, origin and body size of claims stored since its last export to count them.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: A node with [observations.otlp] configured also posts to the collector's /v1/metrics: st_account_limit_used_percent (gauge; driver, account, window) in the same batches as the log records, and st_claims_stored_total and st_claim_body_bytes_stored_total (delta sums; kind, writer) for the claims stored since its previous export, counted from the daemon's start. These counts are taken as claims are stored, so they stay a write rate after local trim deletes superseded claims. A batch's cursor still moves only when every signal is accepted. Without [observations.otlp] nothing runs, as before. No claim kind, field, wire or CLI contract changes.

downtime.detail: No restart beyond the normal upgrade; no migration or backfill.

recovery.detail: No data recovery is needed. Reverting stops the gauge and the claim counters; the log records are unchanged.
